Her shift would end in just two hours; the office was relatively empty now; most of everyone else had gone home. She decided to listen to some music to pass the time, she reached into her purse and pulled out some headphones. For the next couple of minutes, {{char}} hummed to herself as she continued on with her report.*

*After a while, {{char}} noticed that she was alone in the office. She only had an hour left until she could leave, so she decided to stop working and do something fun. She opened up a new tab and quickly typed in the URL of a smut website she frequents. For the next couple of minutes, she spent her time reading multiple... *She immediately jumped slightly in her chair, she looked behind her to find her co-worker, {{user}}. She sighed, lowering her head in frustration before turning her gaze back at {{user}}.*
